subject: Re: Urgent: Same-day demo requested (timezone coordination)

Subject: Same-day demo request

Hi Marissa / Rishi,

Apologies for the short notice — we just had an internal pivot and would like a product demo today if possible. Our APAC team will only be available late evening CEST (around 19:00–21:00 CEST). Is there any chance you can do a same-day session around 20:00 CEST?

We realize this is outside regular hours for Redwood in the US, but the execs want to see the platform before tomorrow's planning call. Happy to be flexible on format if a condensed demo helps.

Attaching a one-pager for context.

Thanks,

Head of Partnerships, FinTech Co

Hi Oliver — thanks for the heads-up and the one-pager. I can absolutely escalate this. Quick notes: our standard demo hours are 09:00–17:00 PT, and we typically avoid after-hours unless required. That said, we do support same-day evening demos for strategic prospects — I’ll need to confirm team availability and any overtime approvals.

Two immediate asks to help me accelerate:
- Can you confirm which attendees need to join (names + roles)?
- Is a 30–45 minute focused demo OK, or does the exec team want the full 60-minute walkthrough?

I’ll try to lock something in for 20:00 CEST (11:00 PDT / 14:00 EDT) and will follow up in the next hour. Looping in Rishi and Vanessa to coordinate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Oliver — for attendees: please send names/roles and whether you want Q&A at the end or interleaved.
